objective: Prove: the 204 placements of the 34 three-variable knots, each edge of a square torus carrying the same placed contact with fair visible spokes, fall into 10 classes with equal emergence laws under spoke swap, joint-value swap and reversal; 6 classes have a vacuum and hold nothing on any graph; parity holds exactly the cycle rank and swap-or-order is frustrated by a 2 x 3 domino, so both grow with the area; not-all-equal and 'x or (h != h')' have no frustrating patch; 'x or (h != h')' is consistent exactly when its h != h' edges contain no odd cycle, equivalently no cross cluster and no cluster winding in an odd class, so its emergence is a percolation winding quantity with emergence bounded away from 0 and from infinity at fixed shape; Pinson's conformal formula gives its predicted limit. Check exhaustively on small graphs and tori.
status: Proved by CONTACT-CENSUS-20261022-001A-P001 (V1 prose proof with exhaustive checks; the two-sided bounds argued from cited crossing bounds; Pinson's limit a cited conformal prediction). The 204 placements of the 34 three-variable knots, one contact on every edge of a square torus with fair visible spokes, form 10 classes: six have a vacuum and hold nothing; parity (one frustrated face) and swap-or-order (a frustrated 2 x 3 domino) grow with the area; not-all-equal and 'x or (h != h')' hold only global emergence. 'x or (h != h')' is consistent exactly when its h != h' edges, critical bond percolation, are bipartite (no cross cluster, no odd winding), checked against an independent winding classification on all 262,144 patterns of the 3 x 3 torus; its emergence is bounded away from 0 and from infinity; Pinson's formula predicts 1.508460 bits on square tori with both sides odd and 1.985201 on 1:2 tori.
title: Proof: the census of fair contacts on square tori
